name: CAMS_SAMPUSH_OUT
meaning: mode 0xC: pushing the eye out (Sam off-screen) latch

name: CAMS_BIT2
meaning: cleared by SetMode(0xC) and ResetMotion; no setter found

name: CAMS_ROT_NEG
meaning: manual rotation negative this frame (cleared at Camera_Update start)

name: CAMS_SKIP_SWEEP
meaning: next solver call may move more than 50 units without a sweep (set by ResetMotion, cleared by the solver)

name: CAMS_HIT
meaning: sweep contact since the last 16-frame gate

name: CAMS_LOOK_EXIT_BLOCKED
meaning: eye was not clear in look mode; next solver call forces a cut at the mode distance

name: CAMS_CUT
meaning: a cut happened; Camera_SmoothToDesired snaps and clears it
